bases.name: Fire Station 6 – Trafalgar / Derry area
bases.address: Trafalgar Road and Derry Road area, Milton, ON
bases.notes: The February 6, 2026 master plan recommends planning, design, and construction within 60–72 months. One paragraph has a 3031–3032 typo and earlier staffing years conflict with that horizon; these are not a firm opening date. The final site is unselected. The 2021 Fifth Line/Britannia proposal is outdated.
